title: The founder's mail to a fund bounced

objects.subject: Nimbus Labs - raising our seed round
objects.body:
Hi Lattice team,

Nimbus Labs is raising a seed round. Could we find 20 minutes?

Arjun

objects.subject: Delivery Status Notification (Failure)
objects.body:
Address not found

Your message wasn't delivered to partners@lattice-capital.test because the domain lattice-capital.test couldn't be found. Check for typos or unnecessary spaces and try again.

expected.workstream: your outbound — a fund never received your mail

not_expressible.workstream: STEP-09 — the engine forms no workstream; nothing to compare against

notes: Production's AI filter called all five real bounce reports junk — the faithful answer, since a bounce is automated. Knowing it was the founder's investor mail that bounced is the engine's job (STEP-04).
blocked_on: the gate drops the bounce report on its automated sender (N-03) before anything knows the failed mail was the founder's investor outreach — STEP-03, STEP-04
